attchmntText: Biofil Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Biofil Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 during a Board Meeting held on 14th November 2026. The company reported a net profit of 11.53 Lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to 8.36 Lakhs in the corresponding previous period. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the net profit was 22.44 Lakhs, versus 249.45 Lakhs in the previous year. Earnings per share stood at 0.07 Rupees for the quarter and 0.14 Rupees for the half year. Revenue from operations was 166.87 Lakhs for the quarter and 1401.89 Lakhs for the half year. The statutory auditors, Maheshwari & Gupta, issued an unmodified review report. The company is undertaking renovation of its manufacturing facility, expected to complete within 3 to 6 months.
